title: Credit Utilization
content: Credit utilization is the share of your available revolving credit that you are currently using. Lower utilization usually helps credit scores, and keeping it below 30 percent is a common rule of thumb.

title: Hard Inquiry Impact
content: A hard inquiry can slightly lower a credit score for a short period because it signals new credit seeking. Multiple hard inquiries in a short window may create more pressure than a single inquiry.

title: Payment History Impact
content: Payment history is one of the strongest scoring factors. Recent missed or late payments can lower a score materially and may continue to affect the file until they age.

title: Score Improvement Basics
content: Common ways to improve a score include lowering revolving balances, avoiding new hard inquiries when possible, and keeping every payment on time.
